id.title: Sistem Login Lengkap
id.summary: Sistem autentikasi lengkap dengan manajemen peran dan menu, dibangun dengan CodeIgniter 3.
body: Sistem Login Lengkap adalah kerangka autentikasi siap pakai yang dibangun di atas CodeIgniter 3 dan MySQL. Alih-alih berhenti pada pemeriksaan nama pengguna dan kata sandi, sistem ini sudah membawa perangkat yang biasanya baru dipikirkan belakangan: pendaftaran mandiri, penyuntingan profil, dan penggantian kata sandi.

Yang membedakannya ada pada kendali akses. Peran pengguna, menu, dan submenu disimpan sebagai data di basis data, bukan ditulis permanen di dalam kode. Menu yang muncul menyesuaikan peran akun yang sedang masuk, dan menambah modul baru cukup dilakukan lewat antarmuka pengelolaan menu tanpa menyentuh berkas tampilan.

Karena susunannya netral terhadap jenis aplikasi, proyek ini dipakai sebagai fondasi awal ketika sebuah aplikasi CodeIgniter baru harus langsung memiliki banyak peran pengguna. Kodenya terbuka di GitHub.
features: Masuk dengan nama pengguna dan kata sandi.
Pendaftaran akun mandiri.

Kelola peran pengguna sebagai data, bukan di dalam kode.

en.title: Complete Login System
en.summary: A complete authentication system with role and menu management, built on CodeIgniter 3.
body: Complete Login System is a ready-to-use authentication skeleton built on CodeIgniter 3 and MySQL. Rather than stopping at checking a username and password, it already ships the pieces usually left for later: self-registration, profile editing, and password changes.

What sets it apart is access control. User roles, menus, and submenus live in the database as data rather than being hard-coded. The menu a visitor sees adapts to the role of the account currently signed in, and adding a new module is done through the menu management screens without touching a view file.

Because its structure is neutral about what the application does, the project is used as a starting foundation whenever a new CodeIgniter application needs multiple user roles from day one. The source is open on GitHub.
features: Login with username and password.
Self-service account registration.
User profile editing.
Password changes.
Manage user roles as data rather than in code.
Manage the menus shown for each role.
Manage the submenus under each menu.

en.title: RESTful API Web Client
en.summary: A web-based client implementing the Unirow Tuban E-Thesis RESTful API.
body: RESTful API Web Client is the interface side of the E-Thesis system at PGRI Ronggolawe University Tuban. All of its data is read and written through the E-Thesis RESTful API, so these web pages never touch the database directly — their job is purely to present and collect data through the API. It is built with Laravel.

The system follows a student's thesis journey from beginning to end: title submission, proposal guidance, the proposal seminar, thesis guidance, and the final defence. Each stage has its own status and reviewers, and what appears on screen adapts to the role currently signed in — Admin, Study Programme Admin, Lecturer, or Student.

Proposal seminar and thesis defence results are summarised into reports the study programme can print. Keeping the client separate from the API lets the same system be shared with a mobile application without duplicating the logic in two places.

id.summary: Aplikasi raport digital untuk sekolah setingkat SMP dan PKBM dengan banyak muatan lokal.
body: E-Raport adalah aplikasi penilaian dan pelaporan hasil belajar yang dibangun dengan framework Laravel 7.0, DBMS MySQL, dan templat AdminLTE. Aplikasi ini ditujukan bagi lembaga pendidikan setingkat SMP atau PKBM yang memiliki banyak mata pelajaran muatan lokal, sehingga tidak dapat memakai aplikasi E-Raport bawaan Dinas Pendidikan.

Bentuk penilaian ditentukan oleh kurikulum yang dipakai sekolah, dan aplikasi ini menampung keduanya: KTSP 2006 maupun Kurikulum 2013. Peran penggunanya dipisahkan sesuai tugas masing-masing — admin menyiapkan data induk, guru mata pelajaran mengisi nilai, wali kelas merangkum dan mengesahkan, lalu siswa melihat hasilnya.

Pengisian nilai tidak harus dilakukan satu per satu: data dan nilai dapat diunggah sekaligus lewat impor Excel, sementara data induk serta leger nilai siswa dapat ditarik kembali ke Excel untuk diarsipkan. Berkas raport dan kartu pelajar dihasilkan langsung dalam format PDF yang siap dicetak, dan seluruh tampilannya responsif sehingga guru tetap dapat mengisi nilai dari ponsel.
features: Empat peran pengguna: Admin, Guru, Wali Kelas, dan Siswa.

en.title: E-Raport Application
en.summary: A digital report-card application for junior high schools and PKBM with many local-content subjects.
body: E-Raport is a grading and report-card application built with the Laravel 7.0 framework, MySQL, and the AdminLTE template. It is aimed at junior-high-level schools and PKBM institutions that carry many local-content subjects and therefore cannot use the E-Raport application issued by the Education Office.

The shape of the assessment depends on the curriculum a school follows, and this application accommodates both: KTSP 2006 and the 2013 Curriculum. User roles are separated along the lines of actual duties — admins prepare the master data, subject teachers enter marks, homeroom teachers summarise and sign off, and students view the result.

Marks do not have to be keyed in one at a time: data and scores can be uploaded in bulk through Excel import, while master data and the student mark ledger can be pulled back out to Excel for archiving. Report cards and student ID cards are produced directly as print-ready PDFs, and the whole interface is responsive so teachers can enter marks from a phone.
features: Four user roles: Admin, Teacher, Homeroom Teacher, and Student.

id.title: RESTful API E-Skripsi
id.summary: RESTful API dan dokumentasi E-Skripsi Unirow Tuban dengan format balasan JSON.
body: Ini adalah RESTful API beserta dokumentasinya untuk sistem E-Skripsi — monitoring dan evaluasi tugas akhir mahasiswa — Universitas PGRI Ronggolawe Tuban. API ini menerapkan arsitektur REST dengan format balasan JSON yang didukung hampir semua bahasa pemrograman, sehingga mudah diintegrasikan ke aplikasi mana pun.

Setiap balasan memakai amplop yang sama: status, pesan keterangan, dan data. Bentuk yang konsisten ini membuat klien cukup menulis satu penangan balasan untuk seluruh titik akhir, baik ketika permintaan berhasil maupun gagal. Kode status HTTP dipakai sesuai maknanya dan didaftar lengkap di dokumentasi, sehingga penyebab kegagalan dapat dibedakan tanpa menebak isi pesan.

Titik akhirnya dikelompokkan menurut peran dan alur akademik — autentikasi, profil, data fakultas dan program studi, sampai tahapan skripsi — dan setiap kelompok dirinci beserta parameter serta contoh balasannya. Akses dijaga dengan API Key yang diperoleh lewat pendaftaran, dan versinya diawali pada jalur /api/v1 agar perubahan di kemudian hari tidak merusak klien yang sudah berjalan.
API inilah yang kemudian dipakai bersama oleh klien web dan klien mobile E-Skripsi, membuktikan bahwa logika akademiknya cukup ditulis dan dipelihara satu kali.

en.title: RESTful API E-Skripsi
en.summary: A RESTful API and documentation for the Unirow Tuban E-Thesis system, with JSON responses.
body: This is a RESTful API and its documentation for the E-Thesis system — final-project monitoring and evaluation — at PGRI Ronggolawe University Tuban. It follows a REST architecture with JSON responses supported by virtually every programming language, which makes it straightforward to integrate into any application.

Every response uses the same envelope: status, message, and data. That consistency lets a client write a single response handler for all endpoints, whether the request succeeded or failed. HTTP status codes are used for what they mean and are listed in full in the documentation, so a failure can be told apart without guessing from the message text.

Endpoints are grouped by role and by the academic flow — authentication, profile, faculty and study programme data, through to the thesis stages — and each group is documented with its parameters and sample responses. Access is guarded by an API key obtained through registration, and the path is versioned from the start at /api/v1 so later changes do not break clients already in production.
This is the API the E-Thesis web client and mobile client both consume, proving the academic logic only needs to be written and maintained once.
features: REST architecture with JSON responses.
Uniform response envelope: status, message, and data.
Authentication: login, change password, and logout.

en.title: Employee Management
en.summary: A Laravel system for managing employee data, salaries, divisions, and departments.
body: Employee Management is a web-based HR application that gathers employee, salary, division, and department data into a single database. It is built with Laravel and MySQL, with a Bootstrap interface that adapts from phone screens to wide monitors.

Its master data is layered — countries, states, and cities act as references for employee records — so addresses and placements are recorded consistently instead of being retyped each time. Search can combine several fields at once, and long lists are broken up with pagination to keep pages light.

Access security gets its own attention: an account locks for five minutes after three failed login attempts, and password recovery is available for users who forget theirs. Everything the system holds can be taken out as Excel or PDF files for reporting, and every form is validated before data is stored. The source is open on GitHub.

body: Indonesia Peduli adalah situs penggalangan dana daring tempat siapa pun dapat membuka program donasi dan menerima bantuan langsung dari donatur. Dibangun dengan Laravel 7.x dan terhubung ke gerbang pembayaran daring, sehingga donasi masuk tanpa perlu konfirmasi transfer manual.

Setiap program donasi tampil beserta kisahnya sendiri: target dana, jumlah yang sudah terkumpul berikut kekurangannya, jumlah donatur, dan tanggal berakhir, dilengkapi batang kemajuan yang bergerak seiring donasi bertambah. Pengunjung dapat membaca kisah penggalang, melihat daftar donatur, meninggalkan komentar, serta menyukai dan membagikan program ke media sosial.

Kepercayaan menjadi titik berat rancangannya. Halaman transparansi dan tab penyaluran dana memperlihatkan ke mana dana yang terkumpul dibelanjakan, sementara menu “Donasi Saya” merangkum riwayat donasi tiap pengguna. Kodenya terbuka di GitHub.

en.title: Indonesia Peduli
en.summary: An online fundraising site for donations, built with Laravel and integrated with online payments.
body: Indonesia Peduli is an online fundraising site where anyone can open a donation campaign and receive support directly from donors. It is built with Laravel 7.x and connected to an online payment gateway, so donations arrive without manual transfer confirmation.

Every campaign is presented with its own story: the funding target, the amount raised and what is still missing, the number of donors, and the closing date, together with a progress bar that moves as donations come in. Visitors can read the organiser's story, see the donor list, leave comments, and like or share a campaign on social media.

Trust is the centre of the design. A transparency page and a fund distribution tab show where the money collected is spent, while the “My Donations” menu gathers each user's giving history. The source is open on GitHub.

Its modules follow the parts of a hotel that run behind the scenes: master data holds the categories, suppliers, and references the whole system draws on; the SP records keep official documents and administrative notes in order; payroll handles employee salary calculation; and the asset module tracks inventory from room furnishings to operational equipment.

The dashboard acts as the entry point, summarising the day's operations while offering shortcuts into the main modules, and reports can be generated and exported the moment management needs a summary. On the administrative side, security and access-rights settings keep each user within the modules they are responsible for, while global settings keep system-wide configuration in one place.

en.title: St Pamdes
en.summary: A customer data and water payment application for village water management.
body: St Pamdes was built for village water managers (Pamdes) who used to record customers, meter readings, and payments in a notebook. The application moves that whole routine into a single web-based system built with Laravel 7.0 and MySQL.

Its monthly cycle follows what officers already do in the field: meter readings are recorded per customer, the difference in usage becomes a bill, then the payment is recorded and the receipt printed on the spot. The receipt paper size is configurable so it fits either a receipt printer or the ordinary paper the village office has at hand.

Customers can check their own bills without coming to the office, while managers follow income through transaction reports. For the initial data migration and for reporting to the village administration, data can be imported and exported as Excel files, and reports downloaded as PDF.

en.title: New Student Admission Site
en.summary: A new-student admission information and registration recap site for PKBM Nurul Jadid.
body: The New Student Admission site for PKBM Nurul Jadid Tambakboyo moves a registration that used to be handled at the school's front desk into an online process prospective students can finish from home. It is built with Laravel, MySQL, and a Bootstrap interface.

The front page introduces the programmes the institution runs — equivalency education packages A, B, and C, Functional Literacy Education, and computer courses — then points visitors to a registration flow explained step by step, from the documents to prepare through to the confirmation sent after the form is submitted.

The registration form collects the student's identity, previous school, and the address as written on their family card, using closed option lists wherever the answers should be uniform so the data does not get messy at the source. Every submission is gathered into a recap report the committee can open at any time to track registration numbers and details.
features: Programme information and new-student admission pages.
Online registration flow explained step by step.
Online registration form: student identity, previous school, and address.
Closed option lists for level, religion, citizenship, and graduation year.
Publicly viewable list of registered applicants.
Registration recap report for the committee.
Responsive layout from phone to desktop.

id.title: API Properti
id.summary: RESTful API untuk manajemen properti: listing, penyewa, pembayaran sewa, dan laporan.
body: RESTful API untuk sistem manajemen properti: daftar properti, data penyewa, dan pembayaran sewa. Tiap titik akhir memakai metode HTTP sesuai maknanya — GET, POST, PUT, DELETE — beserta parameter yang didaftar di dokumentasinya.
Autentikasi pengguna menjaga akses, dan format balasannya seragam di seluruh titik akhir sehingga klien web maupun mobile memakai penangan yang sama.
features: Manajemen properti: operasi CRUD untuk data properti.
Manajemen penyewa: operasi CRUD untuk data penyewa.
Pembayaran sewa: pembayaran dicatat, diperbarui, dan dihapus lewat API.
Autentikasi pengguna sebagai penjaga akses tiap titik akhir.
Titik akhir pelaporan yang mengembalikan rekap sewa dalam format JSON.

en.title: Property API
en.summary: A RESTful API for property management: listings, tenants, rent payments, and reporting.
body: A RESTful API for a property management system: property listings, tenant records, and rent payments. Each endpoint uses the HTTP method that matches its meaning — GET, POST, PUT, DELETE — with the parameters listed in its documentation.
User authentication guards access, and the response format is uniform across every endpoint, so web and mobile clients share the same handler.
features: Property management: CRUD operations on property data.
Tenant management: CRUD operations on tenant data.
Rent payments: payments recorded, updated, and deleted through the API.
User authentication guarding access to every endpoint.
Reporting endpoints that return rent summaries as JSON.

id.title: Rental Mobil
id.summary: Sistem pengelolaan data rental mobil berbasis desktop yang dibangun dengan Java.
body: Rental Mobil adalah aplikasi desktop berbasis Java yang dipakai untuk mengelola data penyewaan mobil dari satu jendela kerja. Antarmukanya dirakit dengan Java Swing dan berjalan langsung di komputer petugas, sehingga tidak memerlukan peramban, server web, maupun koneksi internet.

Aplikasi dibuka dengan halaman masuk yang dilengkapi pendaftaran akun petugas sebelum menu data dapat diakses. Di dalamnya, data induk seperti merek dan unit mobil dikelola lewat formulir yang disandingkan dengan tabelnya: hasil penambahan, perubahan, dan penghapusan langsung terlihat pada daftar di sebelahnya tanpa perlu berpindah jendela.

Setiap daftar dibekali pencarian cepat agar catatan tertentu tetap mudah ditemukan ketika datanya sudah menumpuk. Proyek ini dikerjakan sebagai latihan membangun aplikasi desktop berbasis basis data yang utuh — autentikasi pengguna, relasi antartabel, sampai operasi CRUD — dan kodenya terbuka di GitHub.
features: Autentikasi petugas: halaman masuk beserta pendaftaran akun baru.
Data induk merek mobil: tambah, ubah, dan hapus dari satu layar.
Pengelolaan data unit mobil yang disewakan.
Pencatatan data transaksi penyewaan.
Pencarian cepat pada setiap daftar data.
Berjalan sebagai aplikasi desktop Java Swing, tanpa peramban.

en.title: Car Rental
en.summary: A Java-based desktop system for managing car rental data.
body: Car Rental is a Java desktop application for managing car rental data from a single working window. Its interface is built with Java Swing and runs directly on the operator's computer, so it needs no browser, no web server, and no internet connection.

The application opens on a login screen with operator account registration before the data menus become available. Inside, master data such as car brands and units is managed through forms placed beside their tables: additions, edits, and deletions appear in the adjacent list immediately, without switching windows.

Every list carries a quick search so a particular record stays easy to find once the data piles up. The project was built as an exercise in assembling a complete database-backed desktop application — user authentication, table relationships, and full CRUD — and its source is open on GitHub.
features: Operator authentication: login screen plus new account registration.
Car brand master data: add, edit, and delete from one screen.
Management of the rental car units on offer.
Recording of rental transaction data.
Quick search on every data list.
Runs as a Java Swing desktop application, no browser required.

id.title: Sistem Informasi Manajemen Sekolah
id.summary: Platform administrasi sekolah terpadu: akademik, kesiswaan, keuangan, dan persuratan dalam satu sistem dengan enam peran pengguna.
body: Sistem informasi manajemen sekolah yang menyatukan pekerjaan administrasi yang biasanya tersebar di banyak berkas dan spreadsheet. Satu platform menangani data induk sekolah, kesiswaan, keuangan siswa maupun sekolah, dan persuratan — dengan hak akses yang dipisahkan menurut peran masing-masing petugas.

Terdapat enam peran pengguna: Admin, Admin Surat, Admin Keuangan, Guru, Guru BK, dan Siswa. Setiap peran hanya melihat menu dan data yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya, sehingga guru cukup mengisi presensi kelasnya, petugas keuangan tidak menyentuh data akademik, dan siswa hanya melihat catatan dirinya sendiri.

Sistem ini dikembangkan bertahap sejak 2021 dan terus dilanjutkan hingga sekarang — dari sistem persuratan sederhana menjadi platform administrasi sekolah yang utuh, lengkap dengan notifikasi WhatsApp ke wali murid dan panduan interaktif di dalam aplikasi.
features: Enam peran pengguna dengan hak akses terpisah: Admin, Admin Surat, Admin Keuangan, Guru, Guru BK, dan Siswa.
Data master sekolah: profil sekolah, tahun pelajaran, guru, tenaga kependidikan, rombongan belajar, peserta didik, alumni, dan siswa keluar.
Kesiswaan: mata pelajaran, jadwal pelajaran, presensi harian per mata pelajaran oleh guru pengampu.
Sistem poin pelanggaran dengan akumulasi otomatis dan pencatatan oleh Guru BK.
Persuratan digital: klasifikasi, surat masuk dan keluar, disposisi, serta agenda surat.
Keuangan siswa: rincian tagihan, transaksi pembayaran, dan tabungan (setor dan tarik).
Keuangan sekolah: kategori, pencatatan pemasukan dan pengeluaran.
Laporan keuangan, presensi, dan pelanggaran yang dapat diekspor ke Excel maupun PDF.
Notifikasi WhatsApp otomatis ke wali murid untuk presensi, pelanggaran, dan bukti transaksi.
Panduan dalam aplikasi: tur interaktif, dokumentasi, dan bantuan kontekstual per halaman.
Impor data massal lewat berkas Excel dan pencarian cepat pada setiap tabel data.

en.title: School Management Information System
en.summary: An integrated school administration platform covering academics, student affairs, finance, and correspondence across six user roles.
body: A school management information system that consolidates administrative work normally scattered across files and spreadsheets. One platform handles school master data, student affairs, both student and school finances, and correspondence — with access rights separated according to each staff member's role.

There are six user roles: Admin, Correspondence Admin, Finance Admin, Teacher, Counselling Teacher, and Student. Each role sees only the menus and data it is responsible for, so a teacher simply records attendance for their own class, finance staff never touch academic records, and students only see their own information.

The system has been developed incrementally since 2021 and is still being extended — growing from a simple correspondence tool into a complete school administration platform, with WhatsApp notifications to parents and an interactive in-app guide.
features: Six user roles with separated permissions: Admin, Correspondence Admin, Finance Admin, Teacher, Counselling Teacher, and Student.
School master data: school profile, academic year, teachers, staff, study groups, students, alumni, and departed students.
Student affairs: subjects, class timetables, and daily per-subject attendance recorded by the teaching staff.
Violation point system with automatic accumulation, recorded by the counselling teacher.
Digital correspondence: classification, incoming and outgoing mail, disposition, and mail agenda.
Student finances: billing details, payment transactions, and savings (deposits and withdrawals).
School finances: categories plus income and expenditure records.
Financial, attendance, and violation reports exportable to both Excel and PDF.
Automatic WhatsApp notifications to parents for attendance, violations, and transaction receipts.
In-app guidance: interactive tour, documentation, and contextual help on each page.
Bulk data import from Excel files and quick search on every data table.

id.title: Jejaring Sosial Laravel
id.summary: Aplikasi jejaring sosial dengan unggahan, komentar, suka, dan sistem ikuti.
body: Jejaring Sosial Laravel adalah aplikasi media sosial ringkas yang mengangkat alur inti sebuah linimasa: pengguna mendaftar, menulis unggahan, lalu saling menyukai dan mengomentari unggahan satu sama lain. Dibangun dengan Laravel dan basis data MySQL.

Hubungan antarpengguna ditangani lewat sistem ikuti dan berhenti mengikuti. Linimasa tiap orang dirangkai dari unggahan akun yang ia ikuti, sehingga isinya berbeda untuk setiap pengguna — bagian inilah yang menjadi latihan utama dalam menyusun relasi banyak-ke-banyak dan kueri Eloquent yang tetap ringan saat datanya bertambah.

Kebutuhan dasar akun tersedia lengkap sejak awal: pendaftaran, masuk, penyuntingan profil, dan penggantian kata sandi. Kodenya terbuka di GitHub dan dapat dipakai sebagai titik awal aplikasi sosial berskala kecil.
features: Masuk dengan akun terdaftar.
Pendaftaran akun baru.
Penyuntingan profil pengguna.
Penggantian kata sandi.
Menulis unggahan baru.
Mengomentari unggahan pengguna lain.
Menyukai unggahan.
Mengikuti dan berhenti mengikuti pengguna lain.

en.title: Social Network
en.summary: A social network application with posts, comments, likes, and a follow system.
body: Social Network is a compact social media application built around the core loop of a timeline: users register, write posts, then like and comment on each other's posts. It is built with Laravel and a MySQL database.

Relationships between users are handled through a follow and unfollow system. Each person's timeline is assembled from the posts of the accounts they follow, so its contents differ for every user — this is where most of the work went, into many-to-many relationships and Eloquent queries that stay light as the data grows.

The basic account needs are covered from the start: registration, login, profile editing, and password changes. The source is open on GitHub and can serve as a starting point for a small-scale social application.
features: Login with a registered account.
New account registration.
User profile editing.
Password changes.
Write a new post.
Comment on another user's post.
Like a post.
Follow and unfollow other users.

id.title: Sistem Manajemen Surat
id.summary: Pengelolaan surat masuk dan keluar beserta klasifikasi, unggahan berkas, dan cetak agenda.
body: Sistem Manajemen Surat menggantikan buku agenda surat yang biasa ditulis tangan dengan pencatatan digital yang dapat ditelusuri kembali. Surat masuk dan surat keluar dicatat lengkap beserta nomor, tanggal, asal atau tujuan, dan klasifikasinya. Dibangun dengan Laravel, MySQL, dan templat AdminLTE.

Setiap catatan dapat dilampiri berkas hasil pindai, sehingga dokumen aslinya tidak perlu dicari lagi di lemari arsip — semuanya terkumpul dalam galeri berkas yang bisa dibuka langsung dari daftar surat. Klasifikasi surat dikelola sebagai data tersendiri agar penomoran dan pengelompokannya tetap mengikuti aturan kearsipan yang berlaku di instansi.

Akses dipisahkan menjadi dua peran, Admin dan Petugas, dengan kewenangan yang berbeda. Ketika agenda perlu dilaporkan atau diarsipkan secara fisik, daftar surat masuk dan surat keluar dapat dicetak langsung dari sistem. Kodenya terbuka di GitHub.
features: Dua peran pengguna: Admin dan Petugas.
Mengelola data surat masuk dan surat keluar.
Mengunggah berkas hasil pindai surat masuk dan surat keluar.
Mengelola klasifikasi surat.
Mencetak agenda surat masuk dan surat keluar.
Membuka galeri berkas surat masuk dan surat keluar.

en.title: Mail Management System
en.summary: Incoming and outgoing mail management with classification, file uploads, and agenda printing.
body: The Mail Management System replaces the hand-written mail agenda book with digital records that can be traced back later. Incoming and outgoing mail is recorded with its number, date, sender or recipient, and classification. It is built with Laravel, MySQL, and the AdminLTE template.

Each record can carry an attached scan, so the original document no longer has to be hunted down in a filing cabinet — everything is gathered in a file gallery that opens straight from the mail list. Mail classifications are managed as their own data so numbering and grouping keep following the archival rules in force at the institution.

Access is split into two roles, Admin and Officer, with different authority. When the agenda needs to be reported or archived on paper, the incoming and outgoing mail lists can be printed straight from the system. The source is open on GitHub.
features: Two user roles: Admin and Officer.
Manage incoming and outgoing mail records.
Upload scanned files for incoming and outgoing mail.
Manage mail classifications.
Print the incoming and outgoing mail agenda.
Browse the file gallery for incoming and outgoing mail.

id.title: TreePort
id.summary: Sistem backoffice platform Treeport untuk pengelolaan data dan operasi administratif.
body: Sistem backoffice untuk platform Treeport. Isinya menangani katalog produk, dokumen kebijakan, dan pengelolaan akun beserta hak aksesnya.

Isinya berpusat pada katalog: kategori induk menata kelompok produk agar operasional tetap rapi, sementara produk induk menangani variasi tiap produk secara terperinci sehingga satu produk dengan banyak varian tidak perlu didata berulang kali. Di sampingnya tersedia pengelolaan dokumen kebijakan privasi perusahaan yang dapat disunting langsung dari sistem.

Dasbornya menyajikan ikhtisar cepat aktivitas sistem beserta sapaan yang dipersonalisasi, menjadi titik awal sebelum pengguna masuk ke modul yang ia perlukan. Pengelolaan akun dan pengaturan akses berjalan berdampingan: data pengguna dapat dibuat, diubah, dan dihapus, sedangkan peran beserta izinnya menentukan sejauh mana tiap akun boleh bertindak.
Katalog, dokumen, dan akun dikelola dari satu panel, sehingga admin tidak berpindah sistem untuk pekerjaan yang saling berkaitan.
features: Dasbor: ikhtisar aktivitas sistem beserta sapaan yang dipersonalisasi.
Kategori induk: pengelompokan produk agar katalog tetap tertata.
Produk induk (variasi Flurry): variasi tiap produk ditangani terperinci, sehingga produk banyak varian tidak didata berulang.
Kebijakan privasi: dokumen kebijakan privasi perusahaan disunting langsung dari sistem.
Pengaturan pengguna: akun pengguna dibuat, diubah, dan dihapus dari satu tempat.
Pengaturan akses: peran beserta izinnya menentukan sejauh mana tiap akun boleh bertindak.

en.title: TreePort
en.summary: A back-office management system for the Treeport platform, handling data and administration.
body: A back-office system for the Treeport platform. It handles the product catalogue, policy documents, and account management with access rights.

Its contents centre on the catalogue: master categories organise product groups so operations stay tidy, while master products handle each product's variations in detail, sparing a many-variant product from being entered over and over. Alongside them sits management of the company privacy policy document, editable directly from the system.

The dashboard offers a quick overview of system activity together with a personalised greeting, acting as a starting point before users move into the module they need. Account management and access settings work side by side: user records can be created, edited, and deleted, while roles and their permissions decide how far each account may act.
Catalogue, documents, and accounts are managed from one panel, so admins do not switch systems for work that belongs together.
features: Dashboard: an overview of system activity with a personalised greeting.
Master category: product grouping that keeps the catalogue organised.
Master product (Flurry variations): each product's variations handled in detail, so a many-variant product is not entered repeatedly.
Privacy policy: the company privacy policy document edited directly in the system.
User settings: user accounts created, edited, and deleted from one place.
Access settings: roles and their permissions decide how far each account may act.

id.title: API TreePort
id.summary: RESTful API untuk data pohon, spesies, lokasi, pengguna, dan laporan analitik kehutanan.
body: RESTful API yang melayani data kehutanan platform Treeport: catatan pohon, spesies, lokasi penanaman, dan penggunanya.
Metode HTTP dipakai sesuai maknanya — GET, POST, PUT, DELETE — dan tiap titik akhir didokumentasikan beserta parameter serta struktur balasannya.

Datanya tersusun bertingkat: spesies dan lokasi menjadi rujukan bagi tiap catatan pohon, sehingga satu pohon selalu terhubung dengan jenis dan kawasan penanamannya. Dari susunan itulah laporan pertumbuhan pohon dan analisis kesehatan hutan dapat dihitung tanpa perlu menelusuri data mentah satu per satu.

Akses dijaga lewat pendaftaran dan autentikasi pengguna, sementara layanan notifikasi mengirimkan peringatan penting kepada pihak yang berkepentingan ketika ada kondisi yang perlu ditindaklanjuti. Karena balasannya seragam dan terdokumentasi, API ini dapat dipakai klien web maupun perangkat lapangan tanpa penyesuaian khusus di tiap sisi.
features: Manajemen pohon: catatan pohon ditambah, diperbarui, dihapus, dan diambil.
Manajemen spesies: data spesies pohon sebagai rujukan tiap catatan.
Manajemen lokasi: data kawasan hutan dan area penanaman.
Manajemen pengguna: pendaftaran, autentikasi, dan pengelolaan akun.
Pelaporan: data pertumbuhan pohon dan analisis kesehatan hutan.
Notifikasi: peringatan dikirim ketika ada kondisi yang perlu ditindaklanjuti.

en.title: TreePort API
en.summary: A RESTful API for tree, species, location, and user data, with forestry analytics reports.
body: A RESTful API serving the forestry data of the Treeport platform: tree records, species, planting locations, and users.
HTTP methods are used for what they mean — GET, POST, PUT, DELETE — and every endpoint is documented with its parameters and response structure.

Its data is layered: species and locations act as references for every tree record, so a tree is always tied to its kind and to the area where it was planted. That structure is what makes tree growth reports and forest health analysis computable without trawling through raw records one by one.

Access is guarded through user registration and authentication, while the notification service pushes important alerts to the people concerned whenever a condition needs following up. Because its responses are uniform and documented, the API can serve web clients and field devices alike without special handling on either side.
features: Tree management: tree records added, updated, deleted, and retrieved.
Species management: tree species data as the reference for each record.
Location management: forest area and planting area data.
User management: registration, authentication, and account handling.
Reporting: tree growth data and forest health analysis.
Notifications: alerts sent when a condition needs following up.

id.title: St SmartPoint
id.summary: Aplikasi kasir (POS) berbasis web untuk toko dan minimarket: penjualan, stok, pembelian dari supplier, dan laporan dalam satu sistem.
body: St SmartPoint adalah aplikasi Point of Sale berbasis web untuk toko kelontong, minimarket, dan usaha kecil yang membutuhkan sistem kasir sederhana namun lengkap. Karena berjalan di peramban, aplikasi ini bisa dipakai dari komputer kasir mana pun yang terhubung ke jaringan toko tanpa perlu memasang perangkat lunak tambahan.

Layar kasir mengutamakan kecepatan: produk dicari dengan mengetik nama atau memindai SKU, subtotal dan kembalian dihitung langsung, dan seluruh alur bisa dijalankan lewat pintasan papan ketik tanpa menyentuh tetikus. Satu produk dapat dijual dalam satuan berbeda — misalnya rokok per bungkus atau per slop — dengan stok yang tetap terhitung benar.

Sisi admin menangani data master, pencatatan pembelian dari supplier yang otomatis menambah stok, serta laporan penjualan harian, per produk, dan per kasir yang dapat diekspor ke Excel. Dashboard menampilkan tren penjualan, produk terlaris, dan peringatan stok menipis.
features: Dua peran pengguna dengan hak akses terpisah: Admin dan Kasir.
Layar kasir dengan pencarian produk cepat lewat nama atau pemindaian SKU.
Penjualan multi-satuan: satu produk dapat dijual dalam satuan berbeda dengan konversi stok otomatis.
Perhitungan langsung untuk subtotal, diskon per item, pajak, total bayar, dan kembalian.
Tombol nominal cepat dan opsi uang pas untuk mempercepat pembayaran.
Pintasan papan ketik untuk cari, bayar, dan batal transaksi.
Cetak struk ke printer termal 58mm, 80mm, maupun kertas A4 sesuai pengaturan.
Riwayat transaksi kasir dengan kemampuan cetak ulang struk.
Data master: pengguna, kategori, satuan, produk dengan multi-konversi, dan supplier.
Pencatatan pembelian dari supplier yang otomatis menambah stok produk.
Laporan penjualan harian, per produk, dan per kasir dengan ekspor Excel.
Dashboard berisi tren penjualan, produk terlaris, dan peringatan stok kritis.

en.title: St SmartPoint
en.summary: A web-based point-of-sale application for shops and minimarkets: sales, stock, supplier purchasing, and reporting in one system.
body: St SmartPoint is a web-based point-of-sale application for grocery shops, minimarkets, and small businesses that need a checkout system that is simple yet complete. Because it runs in the browser, it can be used from any till computer on the shop network without installing extra software.

The checkout screen is built for speed: products are found by typing a name or scanning an SKU, subtotals and change are calculated as you go, and the whole flow can be driven from the keyboard without touching a mouse. A single product can be sold in different units — a pack or a carton, for example — with stock still counted correctly.

The admin side handles master data, records supplier purchases that automatically increase stock, and produces daily, per-product, and per-cashier sales reports that export to Excel. The dashboard shows the sales trend, best-selling products, and low-stock warnings.
features: Two user roles with separated permissions: Admin and Cashier.
Checkout screen with fast product lookup by name or SKU scan.
Multi-unit selling: one product can be sold in different units with automatic stock conversion.
Live calculation of subtotal, per-item discount, tax, total due, and change.
Quick cash-amount buttons and an exact-amount option to speed up payment.
Keyboard shortcuts for search, pay, and cancel.
Receipt printing to 58mm or 80mm thermal printers, or to A4 paper, per settings.
Cashier transaction history with receipt reprinting.
Master data: users, categories, units, products with multi-unit conversion, and suppliers.
Supplier purchase records that automatically increase product stock.
Daily, per-product, and per-cashier sales reports with Excel export.
Dashboard with sales trend, best-selling products, and critical stock alerts.
